scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:copy: npm run build && npx cap copy
scripts.cap:open:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:open:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android:build: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && echo 'APK ready at android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk'
scripts.android:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && echo 'APK ready at android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk'
scripts.ios:build: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
